programme.title: Amateur Teens
programme.desc: A group of average students at a secondary school in Zürich wrestle with the average teenager’s needs: love and acceptance. But when the growing influence of social media tosses them into the grown-up world of sexuality and aggression, their needs turn dangerous. What follows is a tragedy that blurs the lines between perpetrator and victim, guilt and innocence.

programme.title: Pineville Heist

programme.title: New World Order

programme.title: Paperback

programme.title: Bled White

programme.title: Patient Seven
